correctness.rationale: For S=<a,...,a+k>, sums of m generators fill every integer in [am,(a+k)m]. Original residue-j Apéry threshold is w_j=j+a ceil(j/k), since at least ceil(j/k) increments are needed. Odd a makes multiplication by 2 invertible mod a; for each j the least h≥ceil(j/k) with h≡j mod2 is L_j, giving complete Apéry(T,a)={(j+aL_j)/2}. Maximization over full and final residue blocks yields t odd F=(at−1)/2, t even q≥2 F=at/2−1, t even q=1 F=(a(t−1)−1)/2. Selmer formula sums all L_j into genus [kt(t−1)+2tq−(t−1)(k mod2)−(q mod2)]/4. Independently verified all 625 pairs with odd a from 5 through 53 by 63854 direct membership tests against Apéry minima and gap counts, not used as infinite proof.
